purpose: Acquire traceable real ocean measurements near or intersecting the frozen LOVE-EDEM bisector point and independently test the viewing geometry of the April 12 1950 Palomar nine-transient field from that Earth location.

datasets.meaning: This is actual underway multibeam acoustic acquisition in the SE Atlantic, not a global interpolated map.
datasets.limitation: Coverage bounds do not prove that a swath intersects the exact frozen coordinate; file-level track/swath intersection must be computed before local admission.

datasets.processing: QPS Qimera cleaned and quality assured
datasets.role: Geometry/bathymetry cross-check after raw-track intersection is established

datasets.provenance: British Oceanographic Data Centre cruise M121/GA08 inventory and series documentation
datasets.meaning: Useful regional water-column prior for sound-speed/environmental modelling.
datasets.limitation: Approximately 114 km from the frozen point; it is not local target data and does not establish the exact SSP at the frozen coordinate.

datasets.role: Query real survey polylines against the frozen point or a preregistered radius.
Use high-resolution-only mask/swath polygons and cruise tracks to distinguish genuine multibeam coverage from global background bathymetry.
Regional geological/acoustic context and natural-control corpus.

ocean_real_data_hunt.admission_rule: A dataset becomes FROZEN_POINT_LOCAL_DATA only after an authoritative navigation polyline, swath polygon, ping footprint or station coordinate demonstrates intersection with the frozen point or a preregistered local radius. Broad cruise bounding boxes are insufficient.

target_event.semantic_firewall: These are nine apparent transient detections on a photographic plate, not nine established stars and not an established extraterrestrial phenomenon.

preliminary_geometry.interpretation: The Palomar field is physically visible from the frozen African latitude and can rise to about 59 degrees altitude. This is ordinary Earth-rotation sky visibility and is not a special geographic alignment.

palomar_sky_crosscheck.why_missing_time_matters: Without the exact exposure UTC we cannot validly test simultaneous altitude/azimuth from the frozen point, Sun altitude, solar-reflection geometry, Earth-shadow geometry or any same-instant line-of-sight hypothesis.

parallel_acquisition_plan: Query PANGAEA M121 file-level navigation and compute minimum distance/swath intersection to frozen point.
Query NOAA/NCEI Trackline layers for bathymetry, side-scan, subbottom and seismic lines intersecting preregistered radii around frozen point.
Query GMRT high-resolution-only mask/swath polygons; do not treat background GEBCO-filled grid as multibeam evidence.
Recover MAST DSS SurveyPlateList metadata/FITS header for XE325 exact exposure epoch/time.
Only after exact XE325 UTC recovery compute frozen-point alt/az, Sun/Moon state and Earth-shadow/reflection geometry.
